tools.name: publicrecords--company-social-profile-finder
tools.title: Company Website to LinkedIn & Social Media Links
tools.description:
Company Website to LinkedIn & Social Media Links. Which social profiles belong to this company? Resolves a name, website or Google Maps listing to its LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook handles, with evidence. Instagram and Facebook are returned from the site on the default path, not platform-verified.

When to use: Use when you need the official social profiles of a company: give a website domain, company name, profile URL or Google Maps listing and get its LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook links, each with a confidence score and the evidence behind it. Instagram and Facebook links come from the company's own site on the default path and are not platform-verified. Good for CRM enrichment, lead lists and checking that a handle really belongs to a brand; not for personal profiles, follower counts or posts.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder

queries.title: Identifiers to resolve
queries.description: One per line. A website domain (acme.com), any organization or profile URL (https://www.instagram.com/acme, https://www.linkedin.com/company/acme), a prefixed handle (ig:acme, x:acme, tiktok:acme, yt:@acme, fb:acme, gh:acme), a Google Maps place ID (ChIJ…), an SEC CIK/ticker (cik:320193, ticker:NET), an LEI — or a company name, optionally with a location ("Acme Plumbing, Toronto"). Names resolve only when exactly one candidate is unambiguous; otherwise you get a ranked `candidates` row to pick…

query.title: Single identifier
query.description: One identifier or company name (for agents, Zapier/Make steps, quick checks). Output defaults to compact for a single query.

inputDatasetId.title: Enrich a dataset (on-ramp)
inputDatasetId.description: ID of any dataset — a Google Maps, LinkedIn jobs or company-scraper run, or an uploaded CSV. Each row's website field is resolved and the result is attached to the row as `crosswalk`; all original fields pass through. Leave `queries` empty when using this.

domainField.title: Website field in that dataset
domainField.description: Auto-detected (website, websiteUrl, companyUrl, url, domain, homepage…) when empty.

maxRows.title: Max rows to enrich
maxRows.description: Maximum number of dataset rows to enrich in one run when inputDatasetId is set.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: auto (default): compact for a single `query`, full for batches and datasets. compact: flat record with ids, urls, confidence and a verified flag — best for tool calls and spreadsheets. full: complete record with the evidence trail per link. Options: auto = Auto (compact for one query, full for batches); compact = Compact; full = Full (with evidence).

forceRefresh.title: Force refresh
forceRefresh.description: Ignore the cache and re-resolve every query. Identity-change events are still computed against the cached record.

confidentThreshold.title: Confident-link threshold
confidentThreshold.description: Links at or above this confidence count as confident. Links below are still returned, flagged low confidence.
